record.field: Guest House - Enable/disable views, set up menus and resolve filter ids

website = env.ref('guest_house.website_industry')
to_deactivate = [ 'website_sale.carousel_product_indicators_left', 'website_sale.product_comment', 'website_sale.products_shop_title', 'website.footer_custom', 'website.header_search_box', 'website.header_text_element', 'website.header_visibility_standard', 'website.homepage', 'website.contactus', ] # website.header_call_to_action is active in core, and views/website_templates.xml # ships the website-specific views for option_footer_scrolltop and # template_footer_descriptive already active. Activating those keys here is a # no-op at best: ir.ui.view.write() with a website_id redirects onto the # website-specific view that shares the key, so the generic never flips. to_activate = [ 'website_sale.carousel_product_indicators_bottom', 'website_sale.tax_indication', ]
ctx = {'website_id': website.id}
for xml_id in to_deactivate: env.ref(xml_id).with_context(**ctx).write({'active': False}) for xml_id in to_activate: env.ref(xml_id).with_context(**ctx).write({'active': True})
menus = env['website.menu'] base_domain = [('website_id', '=', website.id)]
# Default menu items to remove: /appointment is copied from the generic menu # tree (website_appointment) onto every new website, /contactus is reachable # through the header "Contact Us" call to action instead. menus.search(base_domain + [('url', 'in', ['/appointment', '/contactus'])]).unlink() # Default menus to rename/reorder menus.search(base_domain + [('url', '=', '/')], limit=1).write({'name': 'Home', 'sequence': 10}) menus.search(base_domain + [('url', '=', '/shop')], limit=1).write({'name': 'Book', 'sequence': 20}) # Add About menu item top_menu = menus.search(base_domain + [('parent_id', '=', False)], limit=1) if not menus.search(base_domain + [('url', '=', '/about-us')]): menus.create({ 'name': 'About', 'url': '/about-us', 'website_id': website.id, 'parent_id': top_menu.id if top_menu else False, 'sequence': 55, })
# Dynamic snippet filters are exported as an xml id wrapped in MARK, because # their database id is not stable across installs. Resolve them now that every # page is loaded. Odd split() parts are the wrapped xml ids. MARK = '__EXPORT_FILTER_XMLID__' for view in env['ir.ui.view'].sudo().search(base_domain + [('arch_db', 'like', MARK)]): parts = (view.arch_db or '').split(MARK) for i in range(1, len(parts), 2): target = env.ref(parts[i], raise_if_not_found=False) parts[i] = str(target.id if target else 0) view.write({'arch_db': ''.join(parts)})
